name: Difference Planes for View-Dependent Radiance Fields
definition: A method to separate view-dependent and Lambertian components during training by associating a difference plane with each camera to capture deviations from the integrated Lambertian content of rays sent through the volume.
summary: Difference Planes is a method that separates view-dependent and Lambertian components using lightweight per-camera planes to isolate specular highlights and resolve shape-radiance ambiguity.
